Name: Elliott Replacement Portrait
Author: feralfinch
Description:
Hello! I'm an artist who recently started playing Stardew Valley and fell in love. When I discovered portrait mods and how easy they were to
implement, I wanted to try my hand. So I have created a series of vanilla inspired characters with a little more detail and a little more flare.

It was difficult to decide how to portray Elliott. His mod appearance is rather varied and, imo, his dialogue/personality doesn't quite match his appearance. I leaned into the 19th century pretty boy a little harder and channeled some anime victorian vampire. This isn't his definitive appearance in my mind, but it works.

Others to come as I finish fiddling and packing files.

+ Requires Content Patcher & SMAPI
[list]
[*]Download my file and unzip
[*]Extract folder into steam/steamapps/common/stardewvalley/mods
[*]Content Patcher must have been run at least once for mods to take effect
[/list]
